run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T10:16:36Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by the loss of the ad service's only pod: frontend's error spans start at 10:16:36Z (after a zero error rate from 09:57:06Z to 10:16:06Z) and are confined to GET /api/data and its client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds. The ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w was deleted at 10:15:34Z by a scale-down of Deployment ad (replicas 1→0, then 0→1 at 10:15:44Z), and every replacement pod was rejected: 10 FailedCreate events from ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 report "exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m". ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory was created at 10:15:24Z, 10 seconds before the pod deletion, with a hard memory limit of 1503238553600m (~1433.6Mi) that is already below the 1901Mi of memory requests held by the 20 running otel-demo pods, so the ad pod (requests 225Mi) can never be admitted; Deployment ad now reports 1 desired, 0 ready, unavailableReplicas 1 and ReplicaFailure FailedCreate, the ad Service has no endpoints, and ad-produced spans stop. Who created the quota or drove ad's replicas to 0 is not knowable here because change history is not integrated. Frontend (and frontend-proxy on ingress) carry the observable errors; the other otel-demo workloads are running 1/1 with no restarts, no OOMKilled containers and no node memory pressure.

claims.text: frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was 0 from 09:57:06Z through 10:16:06Z, then rose from 0.5 spans/s at 10:16:36Z to a peak of about 4.4 spans/s at 10:29:56Z while the whole-service span rate fell from about 57/s to about 41/s and later about 15/s.

frontend's errors are localized to span_name GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, GET and its client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (each rising 0 → about 0.86 spans/s), plus a small tcp.connect error component (max about 0.046 spans/s); GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/cart and /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder all read 0 error rate in the same window.

The only ad pod, ad-554b849958-p226w, was deleted at 10:15:34Z: a Pod event reason Killing message "Stopping container ad", a ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 event SuccessfulDelete "Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-p226w", and Deployment ad events ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0" (10:15:34Z) and "Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1" (10:15:44Z). No pod named ad-* exists in the otel-demo pod list.

Ten ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 FailedCreate events between 10:15:44Z and 10:21:12Z report the exact diagnostic text: 'Error creating: pods "ad-554b849958-..." is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'.

Deployment ad currently has spec.replicas 1, status.unavailableReplicas 1, observedGeneration 3, condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, and condition ReplicaFailure=True reason FailedCreate with the same 'exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory' message; its ad container requests cpu 10m and memory 225Mi.

ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory has creationTimestamp 2026-11-17T10:15:24Z, hard memory 1503238553600m and status.used memory 1901Mi; 1503238553600m is about 1433.6Mi, so the quota's hard limit is already below the namespace's committed requests.

The 20 running otel-demo pods' memory requests (per-pod values including accounting 160Mi, kafka 300Mi, flagd 120Mi+250Mi, fraud-detection 200Mi, otel-collector 150Mi, checkout 128Mi, frontend 100Mi, load-generator 100Mi) sum to 1901Mi, matching ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory status.used exactly, so no 225Mi request can fit under the 1503238553600m hard limit.
The Service ad still selects opentelemetry.io/name=ad on port 8080, but the Endpoints object ad has no subsets, i.e. no ready backend addresses for frontend's gRPC calls.

ad's own span rates (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds, all STATUS_CODE_UNSET) decayed from about 2.4 spans/s at 10:17:36Z to 0 at 10:21:36Z and stayed 0 through 10:29:06Z, consistent with ad's spans stopping when the pod was deleted at 10:15:34Z and the 5-minute rate window rolling off; ad emitted no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series after the 10:16:00Z point (about 0.0037 spans/s flagd EventStream).

frontend-proxy emits its own error spans in the same window on span_name ingress and router frontend egress, rising from 0 at 10:16:00Z to about 0.87 spans/s at 10:21:00Z and declining after 10:29:00Z, i.e. the edge proxy reports failures on the frontend route.

Checked and healthy: all other otel-demo Deployments report 1 desired / 1 ready / 1 available (accounting, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart); no pod in the cluster has a waiting container reason, and the only terminated lastState entries are on control-plane pods kube-apiserver-i-039cb1bb52ad823d2 and kube-controller-manager-i-039cb1bb52ad823d2 (exit 1).

Node-level and pod-level memory-failure explanations are not supported: all five nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure=False, DiskPressure=False and PIDPressure=False, no otel-demo pod shows a terminated lastState (no OOMKilled), and frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is Running/ready with restartCount 0 on node i-051106caa267a5e9c.

The flagd fault-injection flags that could otherwise break ad (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, and the other failure/latency flags) all read defaultVariant 'off' in ConfigMap flagd-config key demo.flagd.json as read at 10:33Z; this is the ConfigMap definition only and does not prove flagd's runtime variant state during the window.

Rejected: the ad container crashing or being OOM-killed caused the outage. The ad pod's recorded termination is the graceful deletion 'Stopping container ad' plus ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete at 10:15:34Z; there is no Evicted/OOMKilled event for ad and the replacement pods never started because the API server refused to create them.

Deployment ad's replicas being driven to 0 at 10:15:34Z (generation 3, ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 unchanged and created 09:45:07Z) removed the only ad pod; the scale-down and the quota creation 10 seconds earlier look like one coordinated change, but neither the actor nor the intent is observable here (change history is not integrated).

Recommendation for the owners: set ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory's hard memory above the current committed 1901Mi plus ad's 225Mi (for example by raising hard or reducing other pods' requests) so ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can create a pod, then confirm Deployment ad reaches 1 ready replica, Endpoints ad gains a subset and frontend's GET /api/data error rate returns to its pre-10:16:36Z level of 0.

gaps: Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so the identity of whoever/whatever created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 10:15:24Z and scaled Deployment ad to 0 at 10:15:34Z cannot be verified.
The pre-deletion ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its application logs and previous-container state cannot be read; ad's runtime behavior just before 10:15:34Z is unknown.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 returned 0 lines for 10:16:00Z-10:32:26Z, so the frontend-side error text (e.g. the exact gRPC failure for AdService/GetAds) is unverified.

Jaeger returned no spans for frontend or ad in the 10:10:00Z-10:32:26Z searches even though both names appear in traces_list_services, so span-level error details and parent-child call edges for the failing requests could not be inspected.

The metrics http_server_request_duration_seconds_count (no series for any label set) and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready and kube_resourcequota (no series for namespace otel-demo/deployment ad) were not present, so an HTTP status-code breakdown for frontend and a metric-based pod-readiness history for ad could not be obtained.

No Prometheus rule named RequestErrorRate was returned, so the alert's exact expression and the 5.0888 value's units could not be verified; missing STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, kafka, product-catalog, quote and shipping are unknown rather than proven zero.
flagd's runtime flag values during the incident could not be read; only the ConfigMap defaults were visible.
next_steps: Review cluster audit logs (outside this Run) to identify the principal that created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 2026-11-17T10:15:24Z and changed Deployment ad's replicas at 10:15:34Z.
Raise or re-scope the otel-demo-memory quota so the namespace's committed requests fit, then verify an ad pod is admitted and becomes ready.
After ad recovers, re-check frontend GET /api/data error rate and frontend-proxy ingress error rate for a return to the pre-incident zero baseline.
Inspect flagd's live flag state for adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc to close the remaining injection hypothesis.
